remarks: MUST SEE!!! Charming and beautifully maintained, aluminum-sided upper/lower double in the Town of Tonawanda that is MOVE-IN READY. Step inside to the bright and welcoming living room with original hardwood flooring that flows seamlessly into the spacious dining room with large picture windows allowing an abundance of natural light. The lower unit kitchen features wood cabinetry, attractive Granite counters, and a tile backsplash creating a warm and inviting space with three generous bedrooms and one full bathroom with tile flooring and surround shower. Sip your morning coffee on the welcoming covered/enclosed front entryway three season room while relaxing during perfect Buffalo summers or enjoy the partially fenced backyard for entertaining. The upper unit eat-in kitchen has been recently freshened up and has wood cabinetry with vinyl flooring, one generous bedroom and one full bath making this a great income producing opportunity. Take advantage of the large two car garage with loft upstairs for ample storage, separate electric meters, and laundry in basement for ease of living. Recent updates include Rheem HWT 2021, some windows & garage siding 2016, and a new roof with arch. shingles in 2015. Nestled in an incredibly convenient location steps from Niagara Falls Blvd with local shops, dining, and highly-rated schools, this home offers the perfect blend of comfort and style. Showings begin 9/2/2026. Open House Thursday, 9/17/2026 4:00-6:00 pm.
